Description: Sets the Farming Simulator 22 product key. Found on the DVD case or in your GIANTS purchase confirmation. This key is all that is needed: it is used to look the download up from the [GIANTS download portal](https://eshop.giants-software.com/downloads.php) when the server is updated, and to activate the game on first start. Activation happens automatically and only needs to succeed once per instance. GIANTS licensing requires a separate key for each dedicated server, and a key that is already in use by a game client cannot be used by the server at the same time - players get a connection error if it is

Leave this blank. The download link is looked up automatically from the product key. Set it only to install a specific build, by taking the disc image link from the [GIANTS download portal](https://eshop.giants-software.com/downloads.php). Must be a .img disc image, which is read directly rather than mounted, so no special privileges are needed. Installing needs about 48GB free, settling at roughly 27GB

If set, the game server is started as soon as the dedicated server web interface comes up, instead of waiting for someone to press Start there. The settings the web interface last saved are the ones used, so configure the map, savegame and passwords there and they are reused on every start. Only the game port is overridden, so it always matches the port AMP allocated
Sets the server name shown in the in-game server browser. Leave blank to keep whatever the dedicated server web interface has saved. Applied when AMP starts the game server

Sets the password players must enter to join. Leave blank to keep whatever the dedicated server web interface has saved. Clearing it here does not remove an existing password - clear it in the web interface Applied when AMP starts the game server

Sets the password used for the in-game admin console. This is separate from the Admin Password used for the web interface. Leave blank to keep whatever the dedicated server web interface has saved. Applied when AMP starts the game server
Sets the player slot count. Leave blank to keep whatever the dedicated server web interface has saved. Applied when AMP starts the game server
Sets whether players on other platforms can join. Leave blank to keep whatever the dedicated server web interface has saved. Applied when AMP starts the game server

Sets which of the twenty savegame slots is started when Start Game Server Automatically is set. Leave blank to use whichever slot is selected in the web interface. An empty slot starts a new game using the map and economy settings saved there Applied when AMP starts the game server
Sets the language the server runs in. Leave blank to keep whatever the dedicated server web interface has saved. Applied when AMP starts the game server
Sets how often the server saves, in minutes. Leave blank to keep whatever the dedicated server web interface has saved. Applied when AMP starts the game server
Sets how often the server writes statistics, in minutes. Leave blank to keep whatever the dedicated server web interface has saved. Applied when AMP starts the game server
Sets whether the server pauses the game when no players are connected. Leave blank to keep whatever the dedicated server web interface has saved. Applied when AMP starts the game server
Sets the username for the dedicated server web interface

Sets the password for the dedicated server web interface. If left blank the dedicated server generates its own random password on first start, which can then be read from dedicatedServer.xml in the game installation folder
If set, the web interface is also served over TLS on the Web Interface TLS Port. Requires cert.pem and pk.pem to be present in the game installation folder, which are not shipped with the game

Sets the Proton GE [release version](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/releases) to install. Empty = latest. Example: GE-Proton9-1. Changing this rebuilds the Proton prefix, so the product key is entered again on the next start, which uses another activation against the key. Pin a version to stop the prefix being rebuilt every time a new Proton GE release appears
